mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ex_chat_run_t( id, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, status, route_type, agent_code, runtime_provider, runtime_session_id, run_mode, parent_message_id, user_message_id, assistant_message_id, first_seq, last_seq, cancel_reason, started_at, finished_at, metadata_json, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{status}, #{routeType}, #{agentCode}, #{runtimeProvider}, #{runtimeSessionId}, #{runMode}, #{parentMessageId}, #{userMessageId}, #{assistantMessageId}, #{firstSeq}, #{lastSeq}, #{cancelReason}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{metadataJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ex_chat_run_t SET status = CASE WHEN status IN ('CANCELLING', 'COMPLETED', 'WAITING_USER', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN status ELSE #{status} END, route_type = COALESCE(route_type, #{routeType}), agent_code = COALESCE(agent_code, #{agentCode}), runtime_provider = COALESCE(runtime_provider, #{runtimeProvider}), runtime_session_id = COALESCE(#{runtimeSessionId}, runtime_session_id), run_mode = COALESCE(run_mode, #{runMode}), parent_message_id = COALESCE(parent_message_id, #{parentMessageId}), user_message_id = COALESCE(user_message_id, #{userMessageId}), assistant_message_id = COALESCE(#{assistantMessageId}, assistant_message_id), first_seq = COALESCE(first_seq, #{firstSeq}), last_seq = CASE WHEN status IN ('CANCELLING', 'COMPLETED', 'WAITING_USER', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN last_seq ELSE #{lastSeq} END, cancel_reason = COALESCE(#{cancelReason}, cancel_reason), started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{startedAt}), finished_at = CASE WHEN status IN ('CANCELLING', 'COMPLETED', 'WAITING_USER', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN finished_at ELSE #{finishedAt} END, metadata_json = COALESCE(#{metadataJson}, metadata_json), updated_at = CASE WHEN status IN ('CANCELLING', 'COMPLETED', 'WAITING_USER', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN updated_at ELSE #{updatedAt} END WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE fin_ex_chat_run_t r SET status = #{terminalStatus}, cancel_reason = COALESCE(#{cancelReason}, cancel_reason), finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE r.id = #{runId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e WHERE e.run_id = r.id AND e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND e.user_id = r.user_id AND e.session_id = r.session_id AND e.execution_status = 'RECOVERING' AND e.recovered_by_instance_id = #{recoveredByInstanceId} AND e.fencing_token = #{fencingToken} )
AND r.first_seq IS NULL AND r.updated_at < #{orphanBefore} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e WHERE e.run_id = r.id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_interaction_request_t i WHERE i.id = #{interactionId} AND i.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND i.user_id = r.user_id AND i.session_id = r.session_id AND i.status = 'RESPONDING' AND i.continue_run_id = r.id AND i.updated_at < #{orphanBefore} )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e WHERE e.run_id = r.id )
AND r.first_seq IS NULL AND r.updated_at < #{orphanBefore} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e WHERE e.run_id = r.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_interaction_request_t i WHERE i.continue_run_id = r.id AND i.status = 'RESPONDING' )
AND r.status = 'RUNNING'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e WHERE e.run_id = r.id AND e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND e.user_id = r.user_id AND e.session_id = r.session_id AND e.execution_status = 'RUNNING' AND e.owner_instance_id = #{recoveredByInstanceId} AND e.fencing_token = #{fencingToken} )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e WHERE e.run_id = r.id )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fin_ex_chat_run_t r WHERE r.status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') AND r.first_seq IS NULL AND r.updated_at < #{orphanBefore} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e WHERE e.run_id = r.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_interaction_request_t i WHERE i.continue_run_id = r.id AND i.status = 'RESPONDING' ) ORDER BY r.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
